model_screen.note: One prespecified learning rate per mode; the random initialization arm is descriptive, not eligible for selection.

data_screen.fixed_model: Lowest validation macro delta RMSE among M0/M1/M2/M3, ties favor M0 and then model ID.

confirmation.primary_comparison: Fix the combined candidate when M and D each improve validation. If only one improves, fix that alternative. If neither improves, repeat the better of the two individual alternatives against the baseline and record both negative screens.
confirmation.tie_break: Lower validation macro delta RMSE, then lexical mode ID.
confirmation.promising_trigger: Primary candidate improves macro delta RMSE for all three learning seeds and its paired condition bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero in favor of the candidate. This is a trigger for additional splits, not proof of generalization.

bootstrap.unit: canonical intervention, common resample shared across the arms and averaged learning seeds
